text: Welcome to the Winter Palace, Emperor Alexander. From the shores of the Baltic to the Pacific Ocean, your realm stretches far and wide. Yet Russia's greatness is measured in more than its borders: its future rests with those who till its soil, build its cities, and guard its frontiers. The serfs await freedom, the provinces a voice in their own affairs, and the army reform. Free your people, entrust the zemstvos with the care of their communities, and open the way to education and justice. Let reform strengthen the state, and peace give your subjects time to build.
